title: a 4.2% holder (42M coins) uses 10 wallets, the owner posts the weights of ONE scan: his coins are counted once
note: counted for=42M (real stack 42M) vs against=210M (honest opposition 210M) → rejected; the owner's attempts to enrol the 9 hop wallets were refused with NoWeight: 9/9; finance_daily_bps is 50 (was 50)

title: RESIDUAL: the owner posts LIVE balances one by one → the same 42M coins are counted 10×
note: counted for=420M (real stack 42M) vs against=210M → passes; finance_daily_bps is now 70 (was 50). The open_voting sum check (Σ weights ≤ supply) only caps the multiplier at supply / stack (≈ 23× for 4.2%)

title: cost of the multiplier (both rounds): SOL spent by the ten wallets (token-account rent is paid by the deployer in this harness; the rest is fees)
note: ≈0.00015 SOL in transaction fees; plus ≈0.002 SOL rent per extra token account (9 more) → well under 0.05 SOL in total. The counter (u64) only overflows after ≈18× total supply
